name: Orbit constellation

source.description: Two inspected references circle small elements (avatars, satellites) around a central object on elliptical orbits.

technique: Satellites circling a centre express an ecosystem, a network or attraction, and keep a hold lively without new information.
purpose: Show a hub and its participants; ambient life during a held message.
visual_behaviour: Avatars or dots travel elliptical paths at different speeds, staying upright, scaling slightly with depth.
mechanics: Positions sampled from ellipses into keyframes (finite, deterministic) or a rotating ring with counter-rotated children; depth scale and opacity by angle.
failure_modes: Infinite rotation loops are banned: compute a finite duration
Too many satellites crowd the centre

implementation.approach: Sample ellipse positions like Studio.draw.pen samples paths and chain attr/x-y tweens per satellite; candidate Studio.space.orbit.

provenance.observed: Avatar bubbles orbit a central mark on several ellipses while a counter rises (approx., from overview spacing).
Small satellites orbit a circle and then a triangle.

licensing_notes: Technique only; never use reference avatars or marks.
